title: Jeremiah's Call
description: God calls Jeremiah to be a prophet from his mother's womb and promises to be with him. Despite Jeremiah objecting that he is too young, God puts His words in his mouth and shows him visions of an almond branch and a boiling pot from the north, warning of coming judgment on Judah.
